metadata.title: Unemployment by Career Stage
metadata.description: Monthly unemployment rates across different career stages, showing how unemployment varies between young workers, all workers, recent graduates, and college graduates.

youngWorkers.title: Young Workers
youngWorkers.description: Unemployment rates of young workers (age 22-27 without a bachelor's degree)
youngWorkers.source: U.S. Census Bureau and U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, Current Population Survey (IPUMS)
youngWorkers.notes: Rates are seasonally adjusted and smoothed with a three-month moving average. Young workers are those aged 22 to 27 without a bachelor's degree. All figures exclude those currently enrolled in school. October 2025 results are estimated due to missing data.

allWorkers.title: All Workers
allWorkers.source: U.S. Census Bureau and U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, Current Population Survey (IPUMS)
allWorkers.notes: Rates are seasonally adjusted and smoothed with a three-month moving average. All workers are those aged 16 to 65. All figures exclude those currently enrolled in school. October 2025 results are estimated due to missing data.

recentGraduates.title: Recent Graduates
recentGraduates.description: Unemployment rates of recent college graduates
recentGraduates.source: U.S. Census Bureau and U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, Current Population Survey (IPUMS)
recentGraduates.notes: Rates are seasonally adjusted and smoothed with a three-month moving average. Recent college graduates are those aged 22 to 27 with a bachelor's degree or higher. All figures exclude those currently enrolled in school. October 2025 results are estimated due to missing data.

collegeGraduates.title: College Graduates
collegeGraduates.description: Unemployment rates of all college graduates
collegeGraduates.source: U.S. Census Bureau and U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, Current Population Survey (IPUMS)
collegeGraduates.notes: Rates are seasonally adjusted and smoothed with a three-month moving average. College graduates are those aged 22 to 65 with a bachelor's degree or higher. All figures exclude those currently enrolled in school. October 2025 results are estimated due to missing data.

metadata.title: Underemployment by Career Stage
metadata.description: Monthly underemployment rates for recent college graduates and all college graduates, capturing workers employed part-time for economic reasons or in jobs not requiring a college degree.

recentGraduates.title: Recent Graduates
recentGraduates.description: Underemployment rates of recent college graduates
recentGraduates.source: U.S. Census Bureau and U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, Current Population Survey (IPUMS)
recentGraduates.notes: Rates are seasonally adjusted and smoothed with a three-month moving average. Recent college graduates are those aged 22 to 27 with a bachelor's degree or higher. Underemployment includes those working part-time for economic reasons or in jobs that do not require a college degree. All figures exclude those currently enrolled in school. October 2025 results are estimated due to missing data.

collegeGraduates.title: College Graduates
collegeGraduates.description: Underemployment rates of all college graduates
collegeGraduates.source: U.S. Census Bureau and U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, Current Population Survey (IPUMS)
collegeGraduates.notes: Rates are seasonally adjusted and smoothed with a three-month moving average. College graduates are those aged 22 to 65 with a bachelor's degree or higher. Underemployment includes those working part-time for economic reasons or in jobs that do not require a college degree. All figures exclude those currently enrolled in school. October 2025 results are estimated due to missing data.

metadata.title: Job Postings Index
metadata.description: Daily index of online job postings for software development, IT operations/help desk, and customer service occupations, indexed to February 1, 2020.

softwareDev.title: Software Developer
softwareDev.description: Index of online job postings in software development occupations
softwareDev.source: Indeed Hiring Lab via Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis (FRED), Series IHLIDXUSTPSOFTDEVE
softwareDev.notes: Indeed calculates the index change in seasonally-adjusted job postings since February 1, 2020, the pre-pandemic baseline. Indeed seasonally adjusts each series based on historical patterns in 2017, 2018, and 2019. Each series, including the national trend, occupational sectors, and sub-national geographies, is seasonally adjusted separately. Indeed switched to this new methodology in December 2022 and now reports all historical data using this new methodology. Historical numbers have been revised and may differ significantly from originally reported values. The new methodology applies a detrended seasonal adjustment factor to the index change in job postings.
